responsibility: Defines builtin/special-purpose Rust AST nodes and support structures that are not part of the ordinary parsed syntax class split, centered here on `format_args!` expansion. The file introduces `FormatArgumentKind`, `FormatArgument`, `FormatArguments`, and the `AST::FormatArgs` expression node, which stores parsed formatting template pieces (`Fmt::Pieces`) and argument expressions for later optimization or lowering, giving the frontend a dedicated AST representation for compiler-known formatting macros instead of treating them as generic macro invocations.
